source: ترجمة آلية أعدّها Claude لنص: نص التفسير الميسّر كما قدّمه صاحب المشروع (ملخص المعنى)
translator: Claude (Anthropic) — غير مراجَعة من مترجم بشري
scopeNote: ترجمة للتفسير فقط؛ لا تُترجم الآيات القرآنية. الأصل العربي الحرفي هو المرجع.

tafsir.user-brief-1: Say, O Messenger: I seek refuge and protection in the Lord of mankind, who alone is able to ward off evils from them.
tafsir.user-brief-2: The Sovereign of all people and the Manager of their affairs, who holds complete authority over them.
tafsir.user-brief-3: Their true God, besides whom there is no god worthy of worship.
tafsir.user-brief-4: From the evil of the devil who whispers when one is heedless, and who slinks away and withdraws at the remembrance of God.
tafsir.user-brief-5: The one who sows doubts and evils in human hearts.
tafsir.user-brief-6: This whispering comes from the devils among the jinn, and also from the devils among humankind.
